name: dispute-defender-mobile
description: Android companion app for Dispute Defender: review AI recommendations and approve PayPal dispute responses on the go.

scripts.build:debug: node scripts/copy-engine.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: node scripts/copy-engine.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
